section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section discusses the evolution of body image research, emphasizing the need to study positive body image, particularly body appreciation, rather than solely focusing on pathology. It highlights that predictors of positive body image are distinct from those of negative body image. The aim of the present study is to integrate body appreciation into models of body image and eating behavior, examining interpersonal and intrapersonal variables and its role as a mediator for depressive symptoms and intuitive eating. The section references two qualitative studies (Wood-Barcalow et al., 2010 and Frisén & Holmqvist, 2010) that informed the model variables for the present study.
